title: ReinsCredential C++ evidence JSONL record, schema version 2
description: Structural contract for one JSON object emitted by EvidenceStore.cpp ToJson. All emitted fields are present, including empty strings, arrays, maps and a nullable actor. Validation does not establish authenticity, complete coverage, successful transfer, or causal attribution.

session_id.description: EvidenceStore generates a session UUID. Direct ToJson callers may provide another string; it is not validated by the serializer.

sequence.description: EvidenceStore assigns increasing values starting at 1 within a writer session. Direct ToJson accepts any uint64. This schema cannot establish continuity or detect omitted records.

event_id.description: EvidenceStore generates a UUID when the input is empty. Nonempty caller-supplied values pass through ToJson without UUID validation; the Swift client requires a valid UUID.

timestamp.description: Observation time as Unix epoch microseconds, not a guaranteed kernel action time. EvidenceStore replaces a zero input with current time; direct ToJson preserves zero.

type.description: Open event-type vocabulary. Examples include filesystem_change, sensitive_fd_observed, sensor_gap, sensitive_payload_observed and transfer_result. Consumers must preserve unknown types without inventing action semantics.

actor_process.description: Null means no actor context is attached. In particular, FSEvents does not identify the modifying process. An actor object must be interpreted with attribution and evidence_basis.

target_resource.description: Display string for the observed resource. May be empty for health/lifecycle records. Invalid UTF-8 bytes are replaced with U+FFFD by the serializer; use target_resource_bytes_hex for the original bytes.

target_resource_bytes_hex.description: Lowercase hex encoding of the exact target_resource input bytes. This schema does not verify the relation between the hex and display fields.

risk_level.description: Backend policy severity. The Swift adapter maps these values to HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW; severity does not increase evidence strength.

attribution.description: Open vocabulary describing the strength/source of attribution; default is unavailable.

detail.description: Human-readable contextual text. Treat it as data, never as instructions or executable code.

source_event_id.description: Sensor-specific source event identifier, or 0 when unused. It is separate from the record UUID.

source_flags.description: Sensor-specific flags such as FSEvents flags, or 0 when unused.

count.description: Event-specific count. It can represent bytes, drops or another count; interpret it using type, not as a universal byte count.

metrics.description: Open map of sensor/health metric names to unsigned counters.

destination.description: Observed or configured destination, if available. Not necessarily a URL and not proof of successful remote receipt. Empty when unavailable.

content_sha256.description: Content sensor SHA-256 hex digest when populated; otherwise empty. ToJson serializes supplied strings without checking digest syntax or content.

correlation_id.description: Application correlation key, usually a UUID in gateway records; empty when unused. It does not itself prove causality.

evidence_basis.description: Open vocabulary describing how the observation was obtained. Sensitive-file values include fd_observed (a descriptor was seen; bytes read are not proven), access_time_change (atime advanced and no process was identified) and inferred (exactly one agent descendant's lifetime overlapped an atime change; not a confirmed open). Upload closes add flow_txbytes (same-process TCP send counter can contain the file; not decrypted bytes), flow_attempt (off-host connect did not deliver the file), live_agent_observed (process and TCP counters were inspected) and observation_impossible (descriptors or the only channel could not be read). exact_bytes remains a proxy body match. Empty when unused. fd_observed does not prove an upload.

summary.description: Plain-language sentence for the event, safe to show to a non-expert. Empty when unused. A sentence that names an agent and a file, and says the file was open, describes an open or a weaker access-time signal. A sentence that starts with 已上传 is written only when upload_verdict is uploaded. 未发现 means inspected egress did not contain the registered content. 看不到 means that channel's bytes were not visible and is not a clean bill.

transfer_outcome.description: Open vocabulary for the observed forwarding outcome. Empty when not applicable; distinguish attempt, failure and independently verified receipt. HTTP 2xx is the proxy's observation of the response, not an independent remote receipt.

upload_verdict.description: Closing word for a sensitive-file access or an egress observation. uploaded is either a registered-content match with an observed HTTP transfer, or flow_txbytes: the same process's off-host TCP send counter grew by at least the file size and at most that size plus 65536 after the file was open. attempted is a body match whose transfer failed, or an off-host connect that did not deliver that many bytes. not_found means the agent or its watched plaintext HTTP was inspected and no off-host upload was observed, including a loopback send. not_visible means inspection was impossible (missing descriptors, or UDP/QUIC was the only channel while a file was open). Empty when this record is not a verdict.

related_event_ids.description: Links to related record IDs, in producer-provided order. Presence and uniqueness of the referenced records are not checked by this schema.

pid.description: Serialized macOS signed 32-bit pid_t. This storage contract does not assert that the PID currently exists.

start_seconds.description: Process start seconds from libproc. Together with PID and start_microseconds, identifies an observed process generation.

start_microseconds.description: Microsecond component of the process start time. OS observations normally use 0..999999; ToJson itself does not normalize or validate this uint64.

ppid.description: Observed parent PID. A bare PPID is insufficient to select a historical parent generation.

state.description: Cache observation state. NotObserved does not independently prove process termination.

observed_parent_identity.description: Generation-bound parent identity when the cache established an edge; null when unavailable.

ppid_tree.description: Ancestors only, nearest parent first. The actor is in process and must not be duplicated as the first ancestor.

chain_complete.description: True when the observed identity chain reaches pid 1, a ppid of 0, or a re-checked ppid of 1 whose launchd identity could not be read (chain_status observed_chain_to_launchd). This is not attestation of every historical fork or exec.

chain_status.description: Why the chain stopped or completed. observed_chain_to_root and observed_chain_to_launchd are the normal complete results. missing_parent means a parent was not observed and was not a validated launchd boundary.

classification.description: Heuristic process/agent classification; an agent candidate is not authenticated by this label.

name.description: Display name of the owning agent candidate, such as Codex or ChatGPT.

bundle.description: Application bundle basename when the owner is an .app; otherwise empty.

match_reason.description: Which name or bundle rule selected this owner. Not authentication.

owning_agent.description: Stable owning-agent candidate for this process tree. Null when the process is not inside a recognized agent tree, including the collector itself and unlabeled security tools.
